19292.meaning1: sweats profusely under the arms; perspires heavily from the armpits
19292.meaningLit: from the armpits perspirations would be released

examples.text: n'āhaṃ taṃ passāmi samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, saṅghiṃ gaṇiṃ gaṇ'ācariyaṃ, api arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ paṭijānamānaṃ, yo mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya, yassa na kacchehi sedā mucceyyuṃ.
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, dantebhi dantam'ādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato kacchehi sedā muccanti.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kajaṅgalāyaṃ viharati suveḷuvane. atha kho uttaro māṇavo pārāsiviy'antevāsī yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sunhāto suvilitto'si, annapānena tappito, kaṇṭhe ca te veḷuriyo, agamā nu kajaṅgalaṃ.

19297.synonym: kanaka, jātarūpa, satthuvaṇṇa, suvaṇṇa, sovaṇṇa, haritā, hāṭaka, hirañña, hema

examples.text: sabbasaṃyojan'ātītaṃ, vanā nibbanam'āgataṃ, kāmehi nekkhammarataṃ, muttaṃ selā'va kañcanaṃ.
suvaṇṇavaṇṇo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo kañcanasannibhattaco, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

19299.meaning1: made of gold, jewels and pearls
19299.construction:
kañcana + maṇi + muttakā + a
kañcanamaṇimuttakā + a
19299.commentary: (THIa) kañcanamaṇimuttakan'ti kañcanena maṇimuttāhi ca yuttaṃ, suvaṇṇamayamaṇimuttāhi khacitan'ti attho.

examples.text: kāsikasukhumāni dhāraya, abhiropehi ca mālavaṇṇakaṃ, kañcanamaṇimuttakaṃ bahuṃ, vividhaṃ ābharaṇaṃ karomi te.
